WITH actuation_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN o.apptypeval IN ('Welding', 'Grinding', 'Deburring', 'Palletizing', 'Machine Tending') THEN 'High-Wear' ELSE 'Other' END as job_type,
        COUNT(ad.actreg) as total_actuations
    FROM actuation_data ad
    JOIN operation o ON ad.actoperref = o.operreg
    GROUP BY job_type
),
fault_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN o.apptypeval IN ('Welding', 'Grinding', 'Deburring', 'Palletizing', 'Machine Tending') THEN 'High-Wear' ELSE 'Other' END as job_type,
        COUNT(mf.*) as fault_count
    FROM maintenance_and_fault mf
    JOIN operation o ON mf.upkeepoperation = o.operreg
    WHERE o.apptypeval IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY job_type
)
SELECT 
    ac.job_type,
    ac.total_actuations,
    fc.fault_count,
    ROUND(CAST(fc.fault_count AS numeric) / ac.total_actuations, 4) as failure_rate
FROM actuation_counts ac
JOIN fault_counts fc ON ac.job_type = fc.job_type;
